# @marslanmustafa/prayer-engine — Full LLM Reference

Universal Islamic prayer times, Dahwa-e-Kubra, Qibla compass, and Hijri moon-sighting engine.
Zero external runtime dependencies beyond adhan. Fully typed for TypeScript, Next.js, React Native, Vite, and Node.js.

---

## 1. Installation

```bash
npm install @marslanmustafa/prayer-engine
```

Package exports:
- ESM: `dist/index.mjs`
- CJS: `dist/index.js`
- Types: `dist/index.d.ts`
- Standalone IIFE: `dist/index.global.js` (`window.PrayerEngine`)

---

## 2. Core Concepts & Math

### Dahwa-e-Kubra (ضحوہ کبریٰ)
The Islamic Midday. Defined in Islamic Jurisprudence (Fiqh) as the exact mathematical halfway point between Subh-e-Sadiq (Fajr true dawn) and Maghrib (Sunset):
Formula:
`Dahwa-e-Kubra = Fajr + (Maghrib - Fajr) / 2`

Significance:
1. Legal deadline to make or confirm intention (*Niyyah*) for Ramadan fasts and voluntary fasts.
2. Marks the beginning of the prohibited midday prayer window (*Zawaal*).

### Makrooh Midday Window (Zawaal / مکروہ وقت)
The interval between **Dahwa-e-Kubra** and **Dhuhr start**. Voluntary (Nafl) prayers and Sajdah are strictly prohibited during this window.

### Precautionary Adjustments (Ihtiat / احتیاط)
Traditional calendars apply safety buffer minutes:
- `fajr`: Typically -2 minutes to guarantee Sehri ends before true dawn.
- `maghrib`: Typically +2 to +3 minutes to guarantee complete solar sunset before Iftar.

### Elevation Horizon Dip Correction (بلندی کا فرق)
At elevations above sea level $h$ in meters, the horizon dips:
`delta_t = H(0.8333 + 0.0293 * sqrt(h)) - H(0.8333) seconds`
- Sunrise occurs earlier by `delta_t`.
- Sunset/Maghrib occurs later by `delta_t`.

### Hijri Moon-Sighting Engine
Supports physical sighting (*Ru'yat-e-Hilal*) with an integer offset `adjustment`: `[-2, -1, 0, +1, +2]` days.
- English names: Muharram, Safar, Rabi' al-Awwal, Rabi' al-Thani, Jumada al-Awwal, Jumada al-Thani, Rajab, Sha'ban, Ramadan, Shawwal, Dhu al-Qi'dah, Dhu al-Hijjah.
- Urdu & Arabic month and weekday names included.
- Gyarween Sharif auto-detected on the 11th of every month (`isGyarweenSharif: true`).

---

## 3. TypeScript Interfaces

```typescript
export interface CoordinatesInput {
  latitude: number;
  longitude: number;
}

export interface PrayerAdjustments {
  fajr?: number;
  sunrise?: number;
  dhuhr?: number;
  asr?: number;
  maghrib?: number;
  isha?: number;
}

export interface PrayerCalculationOptions {
  date?: Date;
  params?: CalculationParameters;
  method?:
    | 'Karachi'
    | 'MuslimWorldLeague'
    | 'Egyptian'
    | 'UmmAlQura'
    | 'Dubai'
    | 'MoonsightingCommittee'
    | 'NorthAmerica'
    | 'Kuwait'
    | 'Qatar'
    | 'Singapore'
    | 'Tehran'
    | 'Turkey'
    | 'Other'
    | string;
  madhab?: 'Hanafi' | 'Shafi';
  elevation?: number; // Elevation in meters
  rounding?: 'None' | 'Nearest';
  dhuhrMargin?: 'method' | 'none'; // 'none' = 0 min raw solar noon; 'method' = +1 min
  highLatitudeRule?: 'auto' | 'MiddleOfTheNight' | 'SeventhOfTheNight' | 'TwilightAngle';
  fajrAngle?: number;
  ishaAngle?: number;
  adjustments?: PrayerAdjustments;
}

export interface PrayerTimesResult {
  fajr: Date;
  sunrise: Date; // adjusted for elevation dip
  ishraq: Date; // 20m post-sunrise
  dahwaKubra: Date; // Islamic midday midpoint
  makroohMidday: {
    start: Date; // Dahwa-e-Kubra
    end: Date;   // Dhuhr start
  };
  dhuhr: Date;
  asr: Date; // Hanafi (2x shadow) or Shafi (1x shadow)
  sunset: Date; // adjusted for elevation dip
  maghrib: Date; // adjusted for elevation dip
  isha: Date;
  midnight: Date; // Islamic night midpoint (Maghrib -> next Fajr)
  tahajjud: Date; // Last third of night begins
  currentPrayer: 'none' | 'fajr' | 'sunrise' | 'dhuhr' | 'asr' | 'maghrib' | 'isha';
  nextPrayer: 'none' | 'fajr' | 'sunrise' | 'dhuhr' | 'asr' | 'maghrib' | 'isha';
  qibla: number; // Great-circle Kaaba compass bearing in degrees
  elevation: number;
  elevationShift: number; // in seconds
  adjustments: PrayerAdjustments;
  raw: PrayerTimes;
}

export interface HijriDateResult {
  day: number;
  month: {
    number: number;
    en: string;
    ur: string;
    ar: string;
  };
  year: number;
  dayOfWeek: {
    en: string;
    ur: string;
    ar: string;
  };
  formatted: {
    en: string;
    ur: string;
    ar: string;
  };
  adjustment: number;
  events: Array<{
    name: string;
    nameUrdu: string;
    nameArabic: string;
    hijriMonth: number;
    hijriDay: number;
  }>;
  isGyarweenSharif: boolean;
}
```

---

## 4. Usage Examples

### Standard Usage
```typescript
import { getPrayerTimes, getHijriDate } from '@marslanmustafa/prayer-engine';

const coords = { latitude: 31.5204, longitude: 74.3587 }; // Lahore
const times = getPrayerTimes(coords, new Date(), {
  madhab: 'Hanafi',
  elevation: 210,
  adjustments: { fajr: -2, maghrib: 3 },
});

console.log('Fajr (Sehri Ends):', times.fajr);
console.log('Dahwa-e-Kubra:', times.dahwaKubra);
console.log('Dhuhr:', times.dhuhr);
console.log('Asr (Hanafi):', times.asr);
console.log('Maghrib (Iftar):', times.maghrib);
console.log('Isha:', times.isha);
console.log('Qibla Compass Bearing:', times.qibla);

const hijri = getHijriDate(new Date(), { adjustment: -1 });
console.log('Hijri Date:', hijri.formatted.en, '|', hijri.formatted.ur);
```

### Next.js App Router (Route Handler)
```typescript
// app/api/prayers/route.ts
import { NextResponse } from 'next/server';
import { getPrayerTimes, getHijriDate } from '@marslanmustafa/prayer-engine';

export async function GET(request: Request) {
  const { searchParams } = new URL(request.url);
  const lat = parseFloat(searchParams.get('lat') || '31.5204');
  const lng = parseFloat(searchParams.get('lng') || '74.3587');
  const elevation = parseFloat(searchParams.get('elevation') || '210');

  const prayers = getPrayerTimes({ latitude: lat, longitude: lng }, new Date(), {
    elevation,
    madhab: 'Hanafi',
  });

  return NextResponse.json({
    prayers,
    hijri: getHijriDate(),
  });
}
```

### React Native & Expo
```typescript
import React, { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { View, Text } from 'react-native';
import * as Location from 'expo-location';
import { getPrayerTimes, getHijriDate } from '@marslanmustafa/prayer-engine';

export function PrayerTimesScreen() {
  const [times, setTimes] = useState<any>(null);
  const [hijri, setHijri] = useState<any>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    (async () => {
      const { status } = await Location.requestForegroundPermissionsAsync();
      const loc = status === 'granted'
        ? await Location.getCurrentPositionAsync({})
        : { coords: { latitude: 24.8607, longitude: 67.0011 } };

      setTimes(getPrayerTimes({
        latitude: loc.coords.latitude,
        longitude: loc.coords.longitude,
      }));
      setHijri(getHijriDate());
    })();
  }, []);

  if (!times) return <Text>Loading...</Text>;

  return (
    <View style={{ padding: 20 }}>
      <Text>{hijri?.formatted.ur}</Text>
      <Text>Fajr: {times.fajr.toLocaleTimeString()}</Text>
      <Text>Dahwa-e-Kubra: {times.dahwaKubra.toLocaleTimeString()}</Text>
      <Text>Dhuhr: {times.dhuhr.toLocaleTimeString()}</Text>
      <Text>Asr: {times.asr.toLocaleTimeString()}</Text>
      <Text>Maghrib: {times.maghrib.toLocaleTimeString()}</Text>
      <Text>Isha: {times.isha.toLocaleTimeString()}</Text>
    </View>
  );
}
```
